payload.title: This site is now operated by the software it documents
payload.excerpt: The first post on the official site went through the same command path the page describes.

blocks.content: This page was not edited in an admin panel. A command file was committed to the repository, validated, dry-run, and dispatched to the Worker with a signed request. What you are reading is the result.

A project that claims websites can be operated this way should be operated this way. Every update to this site leaves the same audit trail any installation leaves: an immutable command file, a signed dispatch, and a recorded version.
